description: NeuralGCM-style objective (user decisions 2026-10-20; Kochkov et al. 2024, arXiv 2311.07222, Methods 7.4): Eq. 7 on a vorticity low-passed (closed-box DCT-II, sharp isotropic cutoff) with a cutoff that shrinks with lead time, plus a MSE of the kinetic-energy spectrum (the scorer's definition) and a MSE of the batch-and-lead-time mean filtered vorticity; the two added weights are set once so each added term equals the filtered Eq. 7 term on the first training batch of 1-day windows (the run's first stage, at the random initialisation), then frozen and recorded in the run manifest. Trained from scratch (random initialisation, like exp4), on the rigid-lid truth (rigid lid, phi/g input, 3-hour step and 3-hour loss sampling, fp32 training, symmetric objective, wall ring weighted, in-memory data cache, per-step rematerialisation), curriculum 1, 2, 4, 8 days, 5 epochs each. One seed: exp4's first. The lead-time cutoff table (loss.lead_time_cutoff) is PENDING_TWIN_MEASUREMENT: it comes from a twin measurement the owner has not approved yet, and until it is replaced by {"lead_hours": [0, ...], "cutoff_band": [...]} this configuration refuses to load.
